nodes.statement: QpExRCBindMw starts the Type-2 memory-window access-control test.
The test binds a Type-2 MW over the full MR with local-write access but without remote-write access.
The test enters by creating RC extended-QP client and server players.
The players prepare QPs, the MW bind work request, and the subsequent RDMA write work request.
Setup acquires endpoint contexts, PD/MR resources, QPs, completion queues, and a Type-2 MW.
The MW is retained by its protection domain and QP ownership graph until teardown.
The test increments the MW rkey and successfully binds the MR with only IBV_ACCESS_LOCAL_WRITE.
After successful bind completion, the client posts an RDMA write using the restricted MW rkey.
Polling the client completion surfaces IBV_WC_REM_ACCESS_ERR for that remote write.
Test teardown closes both endpoint contexts after the denial result or an error.
Context.close releases dependent resources before closing each RDMA device context.
The observable client work completion has status IBV_WC_REM_ACCESS_ERR.
The pyverbs test requires successful MW bind completion followed by the exact remote-access denial status.

edges.statement: The test invocation constructs a local-write-only MW access contract.
The restricted MW contract is exercised by newly created RC extended-QP players.
The RC players prepare their QPs and bind/write work requests.
Preparing the operation requires allocation of contexts, memory, queues, and the MW.
The allocated MW remains owned through its PD and QP for the test lifetime.
The retained MW is rebound with a new rkey and local-write-only permissions.
Only after a successful bind completion does the test post the remote write with the restricted rkey.
The posted remote write completes with the remote-access error caused by the restricted MW permissions.
After observing or raising on the completion status, teardown closes both endpoints.
Endpoint teardown releases each context's dependent ownership graph.
The test preserves the polled completion status as its observable denial result before resource release completes.
The oracle compares the observed completion status to IBV_WC_REM_ACCESS_ERR.

disconfirming_checks.statement: The MW bind completion must succeed before the later remote write denial can count as evidence.
EOPNOTSUPP during QPEx or MW setup becomes SkipTest and cannot be classified as a passing denial.
